snippet.title: Goldilock One – Official EA Launch Trailer [2025]  | Indie Action RPG with Survival Elements
snippet.description:
*Early Access Launch set for November

⚔️ Survive the Exile ⚔️  

🌒 You wake up without memories in the frozen outskirts of a new planet — isolated, harsh, and full of mysterious threats.

🕹️ Key Features:
- Local Co-op & Steam Remote Play Together support
- Hack-and-slash-style combat with strategic depth
- Crafting equipment, potions and food as survival elements
- NPC behavior influenced by your decisions and moral choices
- Environmental puzzles and exploration
- Enemies inspired by global mythology and Brazilian folklore

🎮 Play on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427790]  
📢 Join our community on Discord: [https://discord.gg/AXP5R7Q]  
🔔 Follow us for news and updates:  
- Instagram: [@goldilockone](https://instagram.com/goldilockone)  
- Twitter/X: [@goldilockone](https://twitter.com/goldilockone)  
- Official Website: [https://goldilockone.com]

📅 Release: Early Access set for November (Demo available on Steam)
📌 Platform: PC (Steam)

#GoldilockOne #IndieRPG #ActionRPG #BrazilianGame #SteamGame #IndieDev #SciFiFantasy
